items.lede: Kora is set to launch as a free-to-use alternative to Windows, targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.
items.title: After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era

items.lede: Built by Cyanogen’s cofounder, Kora is a next-gen alternative to Windows and macOS built for power users running local AI models.
items.title: This New Linux-Based Desktop Operating System Is Built for AI Nerds

items.lede: Kora, a Linux desktop OS with built-in AI models and agents for local agentic work, is coming to PCs in 2027, including Snapdragon X2 Elite machines.
items.title: Cyanogen co-founder unveils Kora, a Linux OS that splits AI models across the CPU, GPU, and NPU
